base:
Create one adult female HUMAN base character for Echoes Below. Output a landscape 16:9 composition at 2K. Use the attached Elf image as the primary reference for the collection's art style, faceted rendering, clothing, and heroic-chibi proportions, but create a DISTINCT HUMAN FACE and identity, not the Elf with shortened ears.

Follow the character contract: chunky stylized fantasy, head approximately one third of total height, strong readable silhouette at small isometric game scale, simple hand-painted/flat-shaded matte materials, muted colors. Not realistic and not anime. Match the reference's level of detail and softly faceted surfaces.

Distinct Human identity: small rounded ears close to the head, slightly square face, wider soft jaw and chin, broader short nose with rounded tip, slightly narrower almond-shaped brown eyes than the Elf, straighter strong brows, naturally shaped lips and a calm confident expression. Warm medium-tan skin. Dark brown hair swept back into a short practical ponytail with chunky sculpted hair sections and a few broad side locks. Clearly an adult, with stylized adult anatomy. Do not copy the Elf's facial features or short swept bob.

Athletic balanced medium build, moderately broad shoulders, sturdy torso and strong arms and legs. Less slender than the Elf, less stocky than a Dwarf. Maintain the same heroic-chibi collection scale. Plain opaque gray athletic crop top and simple opaque gray fitted shorts matching the reference. Bare feet, empty hands, no equipment or accessories.

One complete character only, centered, straight-on front view, minimal perspective distortion. Relaxed symmetrical A-pose with arms slightly away from torso, unobstructed hands, feet slightly apart. Full head and feet visible with generous margin. Character occupies about 85 percent of image height; plain white space on both sides within the landscape canvas. No extra portraits, panels or duplicate views.

Plain white background, even neutral studio light, subtle contact shadow only. No pointed ears, armor, weapons, jewelry, scenery, pedestal, text, labels or watermark. Avoid glossy skin, fine surface noise, dramatic shadows or realistic adult body proportions.
sheet:
Create a polished landscape character reference sheet for ECHOES BELOW at 2K, 16:9. Use the attached generated female HUMAN base as the exact character identity reference. Preserve her distinct face, brown eyes, warm tan skin, rounded ears, chunky swept dark-brown hair and the small tied-back section, gray opaque athletic top and gray opaque shorts, adult athletic body, and heroic-chibi faceted fantasy style. All views depict the SAME ADULT HUMAN, never an Elf or Dwarf. Do not redesign or change her build, hairstyle or face.

Design a clean warm ivory reference board with dark brown serif typography. Header at top left: "ECHOES BELOW". Subtitle: "FEMALE HUMAN / HEROIC CHIBI / BASE BODY". Thin understated divider beneath the header.

Across the left three quarters, place three equal-scale full-body views on a shared baseline: FRONT facing camera, SIDE in true right-facing profile, BACK facing away. Relaxed neutral A-pose, arms slightly separated, hands visible, feet apart and fully in frame. Maintain exact head size, body width, limb lengths, outfit and hair construction across views. Do not make a muscular Dwarf or a tall realistic Human. Show the hair tie and short ponytail consistently in profile and rear views, following what is visible or implied in the base image.

At right, separate a narrower column with a fine vertical rule. Upper panel: a full-body elevated three-quarter GAME VIEW, as seen from an isometric RPG camera. Lower panel: a head-and-shoulders FACE close-up matching the front view. Add restrained labels FRONT, SIDE, BACK, GAME VIEW, FACE beneath the corresponding images. Spacious readable arrangement; no overlapping figures, clipping, props, armor, weapons or pedestal.

Use the same clean faceted low-poly surfaces and matte flat-color/hand-painted material style as the identity reference, simple large shapes and soft neutral studio lighting. This is 2D concept art for future Tripo modeling, not a wireframe or proof of an existing 3D model. No photorealism, anime styling, dramatic shadows or glossy materials.
sheet_clothed:

CHANGE HER CLOTHING in EVERY panel to a fully opaque plain gray short-sleeved crew-neck tunic covering her shoulders, chest, abdomen, and hips, plus plain gray knee-length shorts. Chunky heroic-chibi fantasy with a large expressive head approximately one third of height, simple readable faceted forms, matte flat-shaded surfaces; follow the existing Elf collection's style without copying an Elf face or pointed ears.

Warm ivory board, dark brown serif title ECHOES BELOW at top left. Subtitle FEMALE HUMAN / HEROIC CHIBI / BASE BODY. Understated fine divider.
Left three quarters: FRONT, SIDE, BACK full-body views at equal scale aligned on a shared baseline. Side is true right-facing profile; back faces away. Right quarter separated by a vertical rule: elevated three-quarter full-body GAME VIEW at top, matching FACE head-and-shoulders close-up below. Correct restrained labels beneath all five views. Generous margins, no cropped feet or hair. Tunic collar visible in face portrait.
